fusions.name: Pollen Drift
fusions.desc: A cone of pollen that deals 8 damage and leaves everything in it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Thorn Flick
fusions.desc: A thrown needle that deals 4 damage, up to 1.6 times its damage at maximum range. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Clover Patch
fusions.desc: Raises a meadow where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally inside 5.5 tiles makes it 11% stronger, to a limit of 4.

fusions.name: Second Bloom
fusions.desc: When a condition expires, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
